integrity: General theorem is proved by irreducible-block analysis and cyclic Fourier root counts. Independent external validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is for arbitrary complex functions on prime dihedral groups with exact support 1 through 4; other fields, larger support, and composite rotation order are not addressed. Prime Fourier full-spark is a cited established premise; sample computations are corroborative.
title: First four exact rank-weighted Fourier uncertainty levels on prime dihedral groups
